segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on while glitching, discusses being a dog, eating bugs, and flea cities on his back.
segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Station Sign-On

segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Jeff Ripple cover the Kilmar Abrego Garcia deportation case, the Chicago Bulls hat as alleged MS-13 evidence, gang designation databases, and the judge's probable cause finding for criminal contempt against the Trump administration. Kendelle walks through mid-segment discussing perfumes and autism tests.
segments.title: News Desk: Immigration Contempt & Gang Designation

segments.notes: Case watches a 10-minute Ego Man compilation video, then interviews the sentient Eggo waffle character who accepts his destiny to be buttered, syruped, and eaten. Papito nearly devours the guest on air.
segments.title: Ego Man Interview

segments.notes: Case attempts to contact Gex 64, who responds with recycled voice lines about eating buttholes of celebrities (Donny Osmond, Walt Whitman, Stephen King, Don Wriggles) and a penis-breaking incident with Sharon Stone.
segments.title: Gex 64 Interview

segments.notes: Case and Durf (Hype Train) review viral videos: Roblox movie recreations, Nigerian giant Omos with Uncle Ruckus voice actor Gary Anthony Williams, Japanese human washing machine game show, butt-waggle dance video, Pokemon/One Piece animation mashup, Thailand trans women conscription lottery, waggling tree, and Katy Perry's Blue Origin space flight.

segments.notes: Guy Redacted returns from censorship to present Filipino Good Friday crucifixion reenactments — grandfather Ruben Enaje nailed to a cross for the 36th time — framing competitive faith as a conspiracy to keep Jesus at max power level.
segments.title: Conspiracy Time: Filipino Jesus Crucifixion Reenactments

segments.notes: Jeff Ripple delivers a rapid-fire news roundup: Bristol Goa Cream festival canceled as torture, Marvel Rivals players lining up for Emma Frost chokeslams, British tennis player Harriet Dart's deodorant comment, NYC subway sexual abuse victim, Trump contempt ruling (reprise), Capcom's 6,000 trademarks award, Madden movie casting, death grip syndrome, WrestleMania 41 card, Trump toilet brush tariffs, Elon Musk's 13th child, Chinese brain-computer interface gaming, Barcelona's Mapi Leon groin-touch incident, Ethiopian holy water cholera outbreak, Jake Paul vs Julio Cesar Chavez Jr. boxing.
segments.title: Jeff Ripple News Roundup

segments.notes: Papito conducts a therapy Q&A revealing he ate Peter Gibbon's toes, consumes pesticides for energy, claims immortality, and would eat a full three-pound bag of weed. Dr. Chath cited as recommending American Spirit 120s.
segments.title: Therapy: Papito Q&A

segments.notes: AI Rooney reboots with exposed internal core to deliver Andy Rooney-style grievances on hard soup, airline food, long traffic lights, Kansas City Royals hats, expensive prices, Eggo suicide, sandless sandwiches, sudden moles, bad air, Mexican restaurant ethnicity thresholds, six-pack beverages, hot sun, and pizza crust semantics.
segments.title: AI Rooney: Viewer Complaints

segments.notes: Yogi Bear remains broken; Papito raids Brie's channel with Kendall as 'beautiful Filipino son' sign-off.
segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the Trump administration's contempt ruling over Kilmar Abrego Garcia's deportation, dissecting the Chicago Bulls hat as gang evidence, before pivoting to viral video reviews including a sentient Eggo waffle, a recycled Gex 64, and Thailand's trans women conscription lottery. The broadcast closed with Papito's therapy session revealing he consumed Peter Gibbon's toes, an AI Rooney reboot with exposed core, and a raid to Brie's channel.
